name: codex-research-writing
description: Project-local authoring/source profile for manuscripts, literature review, citations, source packages, figures, and peer review. Formal research-document PDF production stops at source plus handoff here; use research-main for integrated rendering.
routing_notes: This is an authoring/source/package profile, not the integrated formal-PDF production profile. For new or substantially revised research reports/manuscripts that mention formal PDF, first use Research Authoring (`research-authoring-core`, then report/paper delegates) to produce stable Markdown/LaTeX/source package plus a complete downstream production handoff, then stop.

A globally discoverable renderer does not convert this profile into `research-main`. Generic `pdf`, runtime/file/compute capability, XeLaTeX, latexmk, Pandoc-to-PDF, PDF open/render, page raster/visual inspection, pdftotext, pdfinfo, or pdffonts is not the artifact owner for a new research document from this profile.

For complete formal PDF production, install/use the `research-main` profile so Research Authoring can hand off to the admitted renderer and then resume final scientific QA. Existing-PDF manipulation may still use the generic `pdf` helper when it is truly PDF support work rather than new research-document authorship.
